about: The Rainbow Bridge kit's params for S3 (blender/kit_rainbow_bridge.py build(layout entity, map/frames/S3.json, params=...)), passed by blender/rainbow_bridge_scene.py. Written by the bridge-fit agent (S3 Run 2). Everything not listed is the kit's DEFAULTS: the map's width (8.25 m), feet and crown (5.29 m) are kept as the kit fits them. A post given by id alone stands at its layout position (after the recorded moves in build_choices.json), H = the ground there.

why.posts: The three painted 表木, each built by the kit inside its own map ID (8 m, Ø 0.28 m, an X of boards near the top, a stone footing 0.76 m square), each at its layout point after this agent's recorded moves (choices/bridge.json), H the ground there. S3.prop.bridge_end_post_19026 (south-east): moved 0.55 m south: it was mapped exactly on the est front-wall line of S3.bld.mat_shed_19160 (both est at v 1290), whose mat eave the builder runs 0.3 m out; the painting draws the pole over the shed's west gable, so it stands in front of (south of) it. S3.prop.bridge_end_post_20050 (north-east): 0.33 m from the mapped north-east foot of the painted deck, which on the built bridge is beside the north abutment (station 21.1, 0.8 m outside the near railing, its footing 0.08 m clear of the abutment's return); moved 0.44 m inland because the river plan's water jog east of the abutment held its pole on the shoreline; the built deck runs on 4.4 m past it (the north ramp extended for the walk limit). S3.prop.bridge_end_post_far_19176 (far side): at its layout point (130.46, 25.85), which against the built bridge is on the north bank 1.2 m behind the river plan's bank top, 2.9 m west of the built far railing at station 14.1 (the crown's south side, as painted: it rises behind the crown's crowd) and 2.2 m clear of the arch's cross-beam caps; its top cross at H ~7.25 shows 2.0 m above the deck there, as painted under the silk's top edge. The second pass's reading (b), a pole behind the deck's far edge on the far bank, is the one the built bridge supports: a far-side twin at the north end (the north-east post's mirror) would stand inside S3.bld.north_bank_shed_19620 at the silk's top edge, and at the south end over the water.
